name: Fencing
summary: Wood fence installation, replacement, repairs, gates and hauling for residential and commercial properties.

faqs.question: Can you repair only the damaged part of a fence?
faqs.answer: Yes, when the remaining fence is structurally serviceable and matching materials are available.

faqs.question: Do you remove the old fence materials?
faqs.answer: Removal and hauling can be included in the written scope and estimate.
